arguments.sql: SELECT products.line AS line, SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS total FROM orders JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id WHERE YEAR(orders.order_date) = 2026 GROUP BY products.line;
